page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines from top to bottom, with a woodcut of a tree and a man with a banner below the text, and the imprint under the woodcut. No margin notes. Manuscript pagination "76" in the upper right corner is handwriting and is left out.

main_text.l: D. JOHANNIS COCCEJI, S.S. Theol. Doct.
ejusdemque Facultatis in Illustri Acad. Lugd. Bat.
A. D. Iunii, loco horisque solitis, ante mer.
[woodcut: tree with banner reading "NON SOLUM" and a man standing beneath it]

page.notes: The "A. D." line reads "A. D. Iunii, loco horisque solitis, ante mer." with "mer" the cut-off end of "meridiem". The date line at the foot is printed as cIↄ IↄC LXVIII, transcribed as MDCLXVIII. Woodcut banner text partly illegible; "NON SOLUM" is the only legible word. Manuscript pagination in the top right corner is not transcribed. Show-through text from the reverse page is visible in the background and is not transcribed.
